state.paragraph: On September 3, 2013, members of Mac-Gray management, representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and representatives of Party A participated in a telephone conference call for Party A to conduct follow-up and confirmatory due diligence.

ledger_rows.Note: Staged disclosure: Party B and Party C (financial) to get broad data-site access; Party A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) limited access, customer data withheld until later.
BofA letter instructed revised written proposals by 09/09/2013 to continue to in-depth evaluation; covered valuation, financing, approvals and diligence focus.
Round 2 due date reached; CSC/Pamplona and Party B submitted; Party A and Party C submitted late and were reviewed on 09/11/2013.
Pamplona committed to 100% of required capital; requested two-week exclusive negotiations; no financing contingency reported.
Equity from affiliated funds plus third-party debt; no firm financing commitment reported.
Financed by outstanding credit facilities or affiliated equity sources; no firm financing commitment reported.
Oral revised indication; no firm financing commitment reported.
Transaction Committee gave MacDonald a limited process overview so he could consider a rollover; he decided he was not interested in rolling over any shares.
Round 3 opened: SC instructed BofA to request final indications by 09/18/2013, signaling possible short exclusivity depending on price and deal certainty.
Round 3 final due date reached; CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party A responded; Party C did not submit.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
